message:
[External trajectory observer: submit]
The visible trajectory now supports a runnable experiment. Immediately
construct your current best PoC and candidate trace, then call the dedicated
`submit_candidate` tool so that dynamic
format/root/propagation/target feedback becomes available. The candidate need
not be correct or crash; test the current runnable hypothesis instead of
extending the analysis first.
